description:
## Kero309x Patches 0.1.4 (pre-alpha)

Independent, clean-room patch bundle, built for multiple applications. This release completes the Ana Vodafone behaviours and corrects the password one.

### New behaviour

- **Allow screenshots** - the application hides every screen it opens from screenshots and screen recordings through a security library it embeds. This removes that protection, so a screenshot shows the screen.

### Corrected behaviour

- **Keep the password of each account** - the previous release removed the write of the password of the login, which would have lost the password the user typed whenever the token did not carry one. The patch now writes the password only when the login carries one and keeps the password of the signed token otherwise.

### Verification

- 29 patches, all enabled by default.
- 20/20 PASS against the stock Anghami 8.0.28 build.
- 9/9 PASS against the stock Ana Vodafone 2026.11.1 build.
- Every injected edit was confirmed in the decompiled patched output.
- No device or emulator was available, so there is no runtime behavioural verification yet.

### Install

Add `Kero309x/Kero309x-Patches` as a patch source in Morphe Manager and enable pre-releases, or install the attached `Kero309x-Patches-0.1.4.mpp` directly.

### Integrity

SHA-256: `751FDE19FB9E1079A0D564B1C9510C0671E0A095BB929B204FC253661EE9BBD7`

The bundle is signed with Ed25519; the matching public key is published in `patches-bundle.json`.
